text:
vivian: heads-up: toggled the streaming "fast-pulse" routing heuristic in the eu canary ~6m ago. now seeing reconnect bursts and an uptick in duplicate billing for a small tenant cohort. alert ALRT-6123 fired. anyone on it? :eyes:

omar: saw ALRT-6123. p95 reconnects jumped on eu shards. link: https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-6123

vivian: logs (redacted):
```
2026-07-11T09:03:12Z INFO route-pulse session=sk-44 prev=eu-west-1 next=eu-north-1
2026-07-11T09:03:12Z INFO resume-accepted session=sk-44 shard=eu-north-1
2026-07-11T09:03:13Z INFO client-retry session=sk-44 shard=eu-west-1
2026-07-11T09:03:14Z WARN quota.duplicate_check session=sk-44 reason=resume-race
2026-07-11T09:03:14Z INFO billed_tokens session=sk-44 tokens=51
```

tess: pattern looks like a race on route-pulse switch: client resumed successfully on new shard, retried fast to the old shard before affinity propagated -> KV prefix miss -> full regen billed. our reconnect/sample_frac is 0.01 so the console missed early per-shard signal.

omar: quick mitigations: 1) temporarily raise `reconnect.sample_frac` to 0.15 for eu regions for 20m 2) enable a 12s "prefer-old-shard" soft window for pulse flips 3) add a per-shard duplicate_billing chart to the canary dashboard with tenant drilldown.

vivian: agree. also propose a cheap billing dedupe in the pipeline keyed by `(resume_id, tenant_id)` with ttl=6s as a safety net while we investigate. low-risk and reversible.

tess: small console-ux ask: show current sampling fractions on the rollout page and a one-click diagnostic bump. we keep getting blindspots from defaults buried in advanced settings.

product-console: noted. we can add a CTA and defaults hint for route-sensitive rollouts this week.

ops-bot: [automated] ALRT-6123 acknowledged by vivian. Incident INC-6123 created. PM ticket PMT-9908 opened.

omar: action list:
- vivian: enable prefer-old-shard TTL=12s for canary (doing now)
- omar: bump reconnect.sample_frac eu->0.15 (20m) and add per-shard duplicate_billing panel
- tess: prototype billing dedupe (resume_id, tenant_id) behind flag TTL=6s
- product-console: add rollout sampling CTA and link to telemetry settings

vivian: making the changes. if duplicate billing doesn't fall in 8m we roll back pulse on the canary.

omar: quick query: duplicate_billing concentrated on eu-west-1 shard and aligns with the pulse flip at T+2m. original shard CPU +10%. pushing dashboard panel now.

tess: small follow-up: we should also add an alert that fires when duplicate_billing_rate / reconnect_rate > 0.4 for any shard during rollouts  good early proxy for misrouted resumes.

vivian: noted. thanks all. monitoring. :thumbsup:
